# `prefer-starts-with`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports `std.mem.find(..., haystack, needle) == 0` (including legacy `indexOf`
calls) prefix tests.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`std.mem.startsWith` states the prefix predicate without exposing a search
position.

## When it fires

The comparison must use exactly zero and a three-argument `std.mem.indexOf`
call. Other position checks remain searches.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn isComment(line: []const u8) bool {
    return std.mem.indexOf(u8, line, "//") == 0;
}
```
